notes.title: The Ratatoskr Update is here!
notes.notes:
[h2]Are you ready, Squirrel Squad?[/h2]

A new rival arrives and joins forces with Mother & Father to destroy the neighborhood! Commanded to whip up a cyclone that wreaks havoc in the neighborhood, Ratatoskr awaits our hero Squirrel atop the debris at the Golden Acorn Tree. Can Squirrel overcome this new challenge and defeat Ratatoskr to save the neighborhood?  

[h3][b]Watch The Ratatoskr Update trailer!
[/b][/h3][previewyoutube=E6SyairX7oU;full][/previewyoutube]

Tackle the new Super Platforming Challenge as you reach new heights navigating the cyclone debris to take on the new boss. But keep a sharp eye—those pesky agents are very motivated to take you out before you get there!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42666094/f3daad8bd1514f610f34c7b14d2a291e684e8731.jpg[/img]

The fight against Ratatoskr is quite unlike the vehicle-based bosses you've faced before. The mythical squirrel moves fast, has a variety of ranged and melee attacks, and is a considerably smaller target! Fortunately, you will be granted a special SMG with a magazine of infinite bullets for the occasion. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42666094/374a8618f592b751fee490d2ac7893f66d9cc8d1.jpg[/img]

Though it is a disputed feature among historians, we wanted our adaptation of Ratatoskr to make use of a horn/tusk in combat. It can use the horn/tusk as a devastating frontal attack, or drill into the ground and burst out from under the player. It can even grow in size and be used as a melee weapon. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42666094/c3251175f34bcf44d70a0d3757486c845d30ec7a.jpg[/img]

Our hero squirrel is not one to comprehend intricacies like blocking and dodging, but it definitely knows a thing or two about shooting! Using the gun and quick reflexes, you will be able to block and even deflect attacks back at Ratatoskr.

[b][h3]UPDATE 1.4.3.0: [/h3][/b]
[b]New levels: [/b]
[list]
[*] Super Platformer level
[*] Ratatoskr boss fight
[/list]
[b]New Outfits: [/b]
[list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42666094/dd1a583844524e2eeb26c2281d61bf6df446b0df.jpg[/img]

[*] "Chained" outfit (a la Chained Together) as a reward for beating the Super Platformer with 0 deaths

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42666094/a6d79bcb8e733769bb15fd5f60f5d27922e3c319.jpg[/img]

[*] Corrupted Norse Squirrel, awarded for beating Ratatoskr

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42666094/159dd228644a935ad779ae7e880b8aae2a5430fc.jpg[/img]

[*] Divine Norse Squirrel, awarded for beating Ratatoskr 3x and then a 4th time, where he will be gold and more difficult

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42666094/fb489ca9fb2a609662a3a96d34fa003a23685e75.jpg[/img]
[/list]

[b][h3]Do you have what it takes to take on Ratatoskr? Play the update now to find out!

notes.title: Introducing the all-new Photo Mode!
notes.notes:
Squirrel With A Gun's Photo Mode allows players (Squirrels) to take a screenshot of whatever zany situation you have managed to pause.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42666094/31b413f3fbd701766974e19a5a33e7ae1cb08d67.jpg[/img]
In [b]"Cam Adjust" mode[/b], you will be able to freely move and turn the camera and even give it a "dutch" angle for dramatic effect. Players can also zoom in/out the camera's Field of View (FoV) to fit your needs.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42666094/0df534a6985c47a3b0126bd41886a3d769efb92c.jpg[/img]
In[b] "Focus" mode[/b], the player can adjust the camera's focus to emulate professional photography. 
[list]
[*] By default, focus is disabled and everything is sharp.
[*] When the focus is set to "player," the camera will automatically focus on our squirrel hero, as it does during gameplay.
[*] When the focus is set to "manual," the player has full control over the focal distance. This is useful for shots where you might want a citizen in focus and the squirrel blurry.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42666094/0bdd01c7f91d192a0714517c698a56a47ce24291.png[/img]
In [b]"Filter" mode[/b], the player can add silly photo filters to the scene, which can change the color, or put an effect on nearby human and squirrel faces (and you can toggle this effect for player only, NPC only, or both). There are 15 photo filters to collect around the world....can you find them all?

Photo mode is a free update for all, so be sure to update and play today to show off all your Squirrel lewks! 


[h3]Stay tuned for more exciting free updates to come: 
[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42666094/29c2b931dff3a9210d808d1aea79d386b281d597.png[/img]

notes.title: Squirrel With A Gun's PC release has been commemorated by a day-long stream of real life squirrels doing squirrel things in someone's garden
notes.notes:
Squirrel with a Gun, that game about squirrels with guns, releases on PC today, August 29, and its developers have decided to commemorate this by allowing its Steam page to play host to a day-long livestream or real squirrels mucking about. As of wrioting, it's still going, and it's pretty cool.

If you're out of the loop, Squirrel With A Gun has gone from ">a thing that just made for fun Twitter videos a few years ago to a thing that's now actually coming out on PC and console, and it's about exactly what you'd have expected, as well as some platforming you might not have.

To celebrate this being the day the game unlocks on Steam and the Epic Store, its developers have elected to throw a livestreamed party for some actual squirrels, with help from a Youtube channel called, Backyard Buddies, which basically looks like it's doing the whole Springwatch thing of letting you watch animals just live their lives. Yep, call your aunt and uncle who own 15 million birdfeeders and take in hedgehogs, the games are catering to them now.

notes.title: Squirrel With A Gun has now loaded a console release date into its pistol alongside the PC bullet it already had, and my hands are very much up
notes.notes:
If you've been on social media over the past couple of years and are into the video game, odds are you've seen or heard of Squirrel with a Gun. It's a game in which you play as a Squirrel with a gun, and it's just had a console release date revealed to go alongside the PC one that's locked in for (checks watch) next week.

We actually reported on Squirrel With A Gun back when it was just short clips of a squirrel firing a gun against the backdrop of one of those early game development non-environments, and everyone was going 'phwoar, that looks like it'd be a fun game'. It now is one, and it's coming out, though it remains to be seen if it'll have the depth or staying power of something like Goat Simulator.

Anyway, having already been slapped with a PC release date of August 29, the game that's emerged from those videos thanks to developer Dee Dee Creations and publisher Maximum Entertainment, the game's now got a proper console one. It'll be hitting Xbox Series X/S and PS5 on October 15 this year, as revealed in the fresh trailer you can watch below.

notes.title: The Post-release Free Content Roadmap is here!
notes.notes:
Hellloooo Squirrel Squad!

Get ready to go nuts because today, at this very moment, we’re unveiling our post-release Squirrel With A Gun Content Roadmap! Yep, you’ve heard that right—the game's launch is just the beginning. Once Squirrel With a Gun is out, we’re not stopping with production and we’ve got a stash of [b]FREE updates [/b]coming your way. 

Curious to know more? You are!? Perfect. In that case let’s cut to the intro music, show that flashy logo animation, and…. let’s go!

Squirrels, feast your eyes on the [b]SEVEN incredible post-release updates[/b], all coming to you for free!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42666094/29c2b931dff3a9210d808d1aea79d386b281d597.png[/img]

[list]
[*] First up, we will introduce [b]Photo Mode[/b] with a free-roaming camera. From daring stunts to stylish poses, show off your squirrel psycho-cool moments in stunning snapshots with the all-new free roam camera. In short, the chaos is  getting cinematic. 
[*] Next is the [b]Super Platforming Challenge level[/b]. This thrilling new level is designed to push your gun-jumping prowess to the limit. 
[*] Around that same timing, you will also get [b]A New Rival[/b]. Just when you thought you had the city (and agents) under control, a mysterious new threat emerges. 
[*] Early next year, the [b]Outfit Variety Pack[/b] is coming your way. Expect a range of swanky new costumes to keep you looking sharp and stylish. 
[*] Spring 2025 will bring the [b]Gravity Gun[/b], a game-changing gadget from the lab that lets you manipulate objects with gravity (imagine the chaos)! 
[*] June 2025 will bring the [b]Squirr-LGBT [/b]update which features a set of pride fits. Be gay, do crime! (Just like squirrels. Yep, look it up—Squirrels can be gay AND do crime.)
[*] And finally, in Summer 2025, a set of new furs will transform your Squirrel into other adorable forest critters. We call this update [b]The Varmint Collection[/b]. Let’s get wild. 
[/list]
[i]Keep in mind that those dates are not final and may change. It is video game development afterall. 
[/i]

We hope that these updates have you as hyped as we are for what's to come. Just five more weeks until we can commit Squirrel crimes together on [b]August 29[/b]!

We’ll be sharing more updates with you as we get along to the finish line, so don't forget to join our Squirrel Squad and follow us on [url=https://x.com/QuiteDan]X[/url] and [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@maximumentmt]TikTok[/url] for the latest news, sneak peeks, and more content from the game.

Stay nutty, and see you soon!

notes.title: Squirrel With A Gun 2024 Dev Log [07]
notes.notes:
Hey there, squirrel squad!

Hope your day is nuttier than a squirrel's breakfast, because it's about to get wild in here. Welcome all to our latest Squirrel With A Gun Dev Log.

First piece of gossip - during your suburban escapades, you'll stumble upon squirrel-sized RC cars scattered all over the streets. If you've saved up enough acorns, you can unlock some seriously sleek racing machines. Not only do they help you zoom around the town at lightning speeds, but they also come in handy for collecting that precious currency. Keep an eye out for hidden racing tracks that will challenge your driving skills. There are some serious acorns to be made there.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42666094/e292a322765bb0ffc87b04784160f0575f93af59.png[/img]
[i]Is it worth unlocking the car? Of course it is![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42666094/5af249a71d565d153a6df9e1df36ecce8ed34082.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42666094/610ee06525936f889eff657c9c0431dca99cbe1c.gif[/img]
[i]Hold tight, as this ride is going to be a bit bumpy!
[/i]

Remember, there are opportunities scattered everywhere, so stay alert. Not everyone in the city is your enemy. Take this guy, for example. He looks down in the dumps because everyone forgot his birthday. If you can bring him a cake, you’ll make his day—and who knows, he might reward you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42666094/d4271ad06b6c47cec1e8c2bf2830094051481ca8.gif[/img]
[i]A sweet cake is a must-have to celebrate a birthday!
[/i]

Speaking of fashion, we’ve got something special for squirrels from the Wild West: a Cowboy Hat! It fits perfectly on your furry little head and definitely adds to your badass vibe. Get ready to strut your stuff with some serious squirrel swagger.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42666094/f1cca8d2615669916d0d43b0f9088f5057823250.png[/img]
[i]A Cowboy Hat on a squirrel - perfection. [/i]

That’s all from us today. If you’re hungry for more updates on the game, follow us on [url=https://x.com/QuiteDan]X[/url] and [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@maximumentmt]TikTok[/url]. And as always, let us know what you think!

notes.title: Squirrel With A Gun 2024 Dev Log [06]
notes.notes:
Hey there, squirrel squad!

Things are heating up in our neck of the woods as we're working hard on getting the game into your hands. We've been adding new content, squashing them bugs, and polishing that gameplay. But fear not, while we're cooking up Squirrel With a Gun, we also wanted to show you some of the things that are waiting for you in the game. 

So, let’s get into it! 

In "Squirrel With a Gun", you can enter local buildings and check what they hide behind those walls. Sure, some of those houses look normal from the outside, but don’t let the external facade fool you. Remember playing 'The Floor is Lava' when you were a kid? (Or maybe as an adult; we don’t judge.) Well, one of the houses has swapped its floor for a bubbling pool of lava. If you come across it, tread carefully and watch your steps. As the treasure on the second floor might just be worth the risk.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42666094/ae3dfaa643c9435dc029a969ca4e018b2b5f039b.gif[/img]
[i]Just your typical neighborhood lava house[/i]

While squirrelling through the open world, keep your little cute peepers peeled for those pesky agents that are hot on your tail. Dodge 'em like a pro or whip out your arsenal and show 'em who's boss (you are a squirrel with a gun, afterall). But hold on to your nuts, because it's not just agents you'll bump into. From folks needing a helping paw to those ripe for a bit of mischief-making, the town is brimming with people who are waiting for a hero like you. Will you answer their call? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42666094/8117a0b2938ead355887551b70369162c5673f90.gif[/img]
[i]Seems like this guy has been pumping iron at home, throwing around that kettlebell. I wonder what a squirrel has anything to do with it.[/i]

And the cherry on top: outfits. Unlock 'em by doing what squirrels do best (trust us, you'll catch on). Who knows, maybe you'll stumble upon our personal favorite, the Eye Patch and Beret combo, hidden away in a top-secret bunker.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42666094/0d05ef2c4232d7d2f2e625c2fd67bdc2ccc00a45.png[/img]

So, there you have it, folks. We hope that you enjoyed our little glimpse into the world of Squirrel with a Gun. Comment below to let us know what you’re most excited to see in our next dev blog!

notes.title: Squirrel With A Gun Dev Log 2022
notes.notes:
🔫🐿[b]HEY SQUIRREL SQUAD![/b] 

Here's a little progress update of the features added in Squirrel With A Gun for the year 2022. We'll try to keep it a bit more regular moving forward.

[previewyoutube=KfNCRhNb4Go;full][/previewyoutube]
Squirrel made a splash as a tech demo in May, which showed off Unreal Engine 5's fur capabilities. It also happened to wield a MAC-10, which was a thing people seemed to like.




[previewyoutube=HHYBiYbEz1E;full][/previewyoutube]
In August, we added a mechanic to rob NPCs, which was a thing people REALLY seemed to like. Squirrel With A Gun went viral and was featured on websites like IGN, PC Gamer, and Kotaku.




[previewyoutube=_shAz7iPdE0;full][/previewyoutube]
Around the same time, we made secret lab location where Squirrel begins its adventure. Squirrel must find a way to disable the energy shield. Otherwise it gets electrocuted and ragdoll'd.




[previewyoutube=KRz15LfZjBI;full][/previewyoutube]
Anyone viewing the steam page is probably familiar with the trailer ːsteamhappyː In retrospect, should have called it alpha footage cuz there's still a ways to go on our squirrely adventure! The trailer features a takedown mechanic, inspired by the Heat Actions in the Yakuza series. It also shows how Squirrel can use a gun's recoil to cross large gaps. And we also see an early look at the neighborhood where he wreaks havoc.




[previewyoutube=vF-kuiuuUOY;full][/previewyoutube]
At some point, we figured that climbing may be an important feature in a squirrel game, so we did just that. Squirrel must sacrifice his held item in order to climb.




[previewyoutube=taM5Wt2h8qA;full][/previewyoutube]
Some time in September, we added a little variety to the Agents' move set by giving them a dive attack. They track your velocity to predict your location when they strike (Inspired by the frustrating accuracy of the machines in the Horizon series). Serpentine! Serpentine!




[previewyoutube=E0_E9HgfdJg;full][/previewyoutube]
We also expanded the pole climbing mechanics to work with a human's limb colliders. Yes, Dan is a huge fan of Shadow of the Colossus.




[previewyoutube=EU1kPzEVsrQ;full][/previewyoutube]
This is an early look at the title screen for Squirrel With A Gun. Navigating the menu dramatically switches the camera, [i]a la[/i] Twisted Metal Black. The only trouble is going to be making enough menu items to fit all the camera angles.




[previewyoutube=csUh1g3CuqE;full][/previewyoutube]
Acorns will be an abundant collectible in the game. We asked the community if they should be regular or golden. Ultimately, we went with "regular," and had bigger plans for a Golden Acorn.




[previewyoutube=ANY_YrXlZUE;full][/previewyoutube]
On Halloween, we took a small break to torment our poor NPC, Remy. This time with a spooky jack o' lantern. 🎃




[previewyoutube=U3zduVlk2k8;full][/previewyoutube]
Pitt, our composer and sound designer, reveals the secret to making the most comical squirrel screams.




[previewyoutube=c8kJxkmZFyA;full][/previewyoutube]
And finally, we have here a gun dispenser! Pay it some acorns and it will unlock, allowing you to spawn some weaponry. Generally, it is meant to dispense only one gun at a time, but perhaps we'll keep the infinite dispenser as a gag.




And there we have it for 2022. We appreciate the Steam community's incredible enthusiasm and support for this game and we look forward to continue development on Squirrel With A Gun! 

Until next time!

notes.title: Squirrel with a Gun is a game about exactly what it sounds like
notes.notes: Hello. Squirrel with a Gun is a game that's coming to video game platform Steam, and it is about a squirrel with a gun. Not a squirrel sized gun, mind you, but like a regular person-scale weapon that it carries around and can use to rob people, solve puzzles, and apparently fight shadowy men in black-style government agents. At least that's what it does in the trailer which is embedded above but which is also on YouTube... Read more.
